Thousands Detained in Delhi Protest Against Election Commission Chief

More than 3,000 protesters were detained by Delhi Police during a demonstration against the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC). Opposition leaders and protesters were taken into custody. Prakash Ambedkar criticized the Centre over restrictions placed on the CJP protesters.
